ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the
B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District symbols and indications as shown on
Map No. 11-J in the area bound by:

      North Kedzie Avenue; a line 50.0 feet north of and parallel to West Cullom
      Avenue; the public alley next west of and parallel to North Kedzie Avenue; and a
      line 225.0 feet north of and parallel to West Cullom Avenue,

to those of a M1-1, Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                     __________________________
                                                     Rossana Rodriguez Sanchez
                                                     Alderwoman, 33rd Ward




Common Address:
4310 N. Kedzie Avenue
